preservation_note: All earlier CSS blocks, media, keyframes and executable scripts are retained; the earlier V22 script only changes two WhatsApp dialog labels. The 38 legacy inquiry dialogs have no public trigger; seven discovery forms remain.
limitations: Chromium tested; physical iPhone/Safari and Firefox not tested.
Browser interaction coverage is representative, not every possible input combination.
CSP browser fixture enforces the production script/style directives; full Apache/CDN processing is not tested.
The owner-operated /masuk.html backend is not in the supplied archive; URL construction is tested, not live authentication or payment.
No external message, payment or deployment was performed.
